import pandas as pd
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
sub = df[(df['BillingPeriodStart']=='2026-08-01') & (df['ChargeCategory']=='Usage')]
total = sum(Decimal(str(b)) - Decimal(str(e)) for b, e in zip(sub['BilledCost'], sub['EffectiveCost']))
print(total)
print(total.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
